title: Solana ETFs End a 14-Week Buying Streak With Their Largest Weekly Exit
summary: US spot Solana (SOL) exchange-traded funds (ETFs) lost $24.8 million in the week ending October 9. It was their largest weekly outflow since launch in October 2025 and ended 14 straight inflow weeks. Just 2 weeks earlier, the funds drew $188.2 million, their second-biggest week on record.
